commandAcquisitionCorrections.name: Quick Blitz
commandAcquisitionCorrections.sourceAcquisition: Sora and Riku can purchase Quick Blitz from the Shop for 400 munny, or 320 munny during Bargain Flurry.
commandAcquisitionCorrections.replacement: Sora and Riku can purchase Quick Blitz from the Moogle Shop for 100 munny, or 80 munny during Bargain Flurry, at Shop LV 1.
commandAcquisitionCorrections.basis: The DDD infobox itself says buy=100, bargain=80, shop=1; complete Moogle and independent GamerGuides shop tables agree. The same article prose says 400/320. Adopt mutually corroborated structured values; preserve the conflicting raw extraction. PS4 GameFAQs answer465557 indexed excerpt independently describes80instead100; full page access was blocked. No Steam measurement claimed.

sweetDreams.instructions: Sweet Dreams is delivered to the character who clears the Secret Cup. For the other copy, switch characters and replay the Secret Cup; verify ownership separately for Sora and Riku. Star ranks are a separate Flick Rush completion goal, not an additional Keyblade requirement.
sweetDreams.uncertainty: HD player documentation supports character-specific delivery. Exact minimum replay scope and Steam event retrigger details are not independently verified.

reportedInteraction.quality: Indexed first-hand PS4 HD player report; full forum retrieval restricted; not independently Steam-verified.
